# Systematic Literature Review Outline: The Impact of Big Data Analytics on Education Quality Delivery

## 1. Introduction
- Background on big data analytics in education
- Definition of education quality delivery
- Scope and significance of the research problem
- Rationale for the systematic review
- Objectives of the review

## 2. Research Questions
- Primary research question on big data analytics impact on education quality
- Secondary research questions on mechanisms, contexts, and outcomes
- Population, Intervention, Comparator, Outcome (PICO) framework specification

## 3. Search Strategy
- **Databases:** PubMed/MEDLINE, ERIC, Web of Science, Scopus, Education Source, ProQuest Dissertations & Theses
- **Search String:** (("big data" OR "data analytics" OR "learning analytics" OR "educational data mining") AND ("education quality" OR "educational quality" OR "learning outcomes" OR "student achievement" OR "educational effectiveness"))
- Search limits: publication year, language, document type
- Hand-searching of key journals and reference lists

## 4. Inclusion/Exclusion Criteria
- **Inclusion criteria:** peer-reviewed studies, grey literature reports, empirical research designs, publication date range, language specifications, focus on big data analytics application in educational settings
- **Exclusion criteria:** opinion pieces, editorials, studies without measurable quality metrics, non-English language (if applicable), studies predating adoption period of analytics tools
- **Study design specifications:** RCTs, quasi-experimental, observational, mixed-methods designs included
- **Population:** K-12, higher education, vocational training institutions

## 5. PRISMA Flow (Identification, Screening, Eligibility, Included)
- **Identification:** Total records identified through database searching (n=__); additional records through hand-searching (n=__)
- **Screening:** Records after deduplication (n=__); records screened by title/abstract (n=__); records excluded (n=__)
- **Eligibility:** Full-text articles assessed for eligibility (n=__); articles excluded with reasons (n=__)
- **Included:** Final studies included in qualitative synthesis (n=__); studies included in quantitative synthesis/meta-analysis (n=__)
- PRISMA flow diagram with decision points and exclusion reasons at each stage

## 6. Data Extraction
- Study characteristics: author, year, country, study design, sample size
- Intervention description: type of big data analytics tool, implementation context, duration
- Participant information: education level, institution type, demographic characteristics
- Outcome measures: specific education quality indicators measured, data collection methods
- Effect sizes and reported statistics
- Standardized data extraction form and pilot testing procedures
- Inter-rater reliability assessment (kappa values)

## 7. Quality Assessment
- Quality assessment tool selection (e.g., ROBINS-I, GRADE, Cochrane Risk of Bias)
- Domains assessed: study design appropriateness, selection bias, measurement validity, attrition, confounding
- Quality scoring methodology and threshold determination
- Sensitivity analysis stratified by study quality
- Summary of risk of bias across studies (table and visual representation)

## 8. Synthesis of Findings
- Narrative synthesis: thematic analysis of included studies, patterns and themes related to big data impact
- Subgroup analysis: by education level, analytics type, outcome category, institution size
- Meta-analysis (if applicable): pooled effect sizes, 95% confidence intervals, heterogeneity testing (I²)
- Meta-regression: examining sources of heterogeneity across moderating variables
- Publication bias assessment (funnel plots, Egger's test)

## 9. Discussion
- Summary of main findings in relation to research questions
- Comparison with existing literature and theoretical frameworks
